name: omniget
description: Download Udemy and Hotmart courses, YouTube videos, music and books — 1,800+ sites, no terminal. Free open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader and music library. Powered by yt-dlp. Your files stay on your computer.
readme_summary: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading media from over 1,800 websites, including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It integrates a media player, EPUB reader, and music library, all powered by yt-dlp, ensuring user files remain on their local computer.
key_features: Download courses from Udemy and Hotmart
Download YouTube videos and other media from 1,800+ sites
Built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library
Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux
primary_use_case: A unified desktop application for downloading and managing various types of digital media, including online courses, videos, music, and books, with integrated tools for consumption and study.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot librarian meticulously organizing a vast, colorful library. Bookshelves overflow with digital icons representing courses, videos, and music. The robot is shown taking a glowing stream of data from a stylized internet cloud and neatly placing it onto a shelf labeled 'OmniGet Library'. In the foreground, a user is shown comfortably reading an EPUB on a tablet and listening to music from a stylized speaker. Subtle UI elements of the OmniGet app are visible on a nearby screen. The scene is bright, clean, and inviting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and user-friendliness.

name: voidauth
description: Single Sign-On for Your Self-Hosted Universe
readme_summary: VoidAuth is an open-source Single Sign-On (SSO) solution designed for self-hosted applications. It acts as a central authentication provider, simplifying user management and access control across a user's personal digital universe.
key_features: Multi-factor Authentication, Passkeys, and Passkey-Only Accounts
primary_use_case: To provide a unified and secure authentication system for users managing multiple self-hosted applications, enabling single sign-on and centralized user management.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, friendly robot butler standing at the entrance of a grand, interconnected mansion representing a self-hosted universe. The robot holds a single, glowing keycard that grants access to all doors within the mansion. Each door is labeled with a different self-hosted application icon (e.g., a cloud for a file server, a film reel for a media server). Subtle digital particles flow from the keycard to the doors, symbolizing secure authentication. The robot's chest subtly displays the 'VoidAuth' logo. The scene is rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a warm, inviting color palette, emphasizing security and ease of access.

name: Secare
readme_summary: Secare is a browser extension designed to help users regain control over YouTube's user interface. It allows users to selectively hide distracting elements like Shorts, recommendations, comments, and sidebars, creating a more focused viewing experience tailored to individual preferences.
key_features: Clean up Watching (sidebar, description, comments, channel controls)
Tame the Header (hide menu, country selector, voice search, profile)
primary_use_case: Customizing and decluttering the YouTube interface to improve user focus and reduce distractions.
cover_image_prompt: A digital sculptor meticulously chiseling away unwanted elements from a large, glowing block of YouTube's interface. The sculptor uses a laser tool to precisely remove distractions like 'Shorts' icons, comment bubbles, and recommendation boxes, revealing a clean, focused video player underneath. Subtle UI elements from the Secare extension are visible on a small floating screen nearby, showing the user's customization choices. The background is a minimalist digital space with soft, focused lighting. The overall mood is one of control and clarity. Rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a modern color palette.

name: whitebox
description: whitebox is a Prometheus exporter that provides availability monitoring of external VPN services powered by VMESS, VLESS, TROJAN, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, Shadowsocks and Hysteria2.
readme_summary: whitebox is a Go-based Prometheus exporter designed for monitoring the availability of various external VPN services. It supports multiple protocols like VMESS, VLESS, Trojan, WireGuard, and Shadowsocks, offering on-demand or scheduled connectivity checks and exposing results as Prometheus metrics.
key_features: Multi-protocol VPN Probing (VMESS, VLESS, Trojan, Wireguard, AmneziaWG, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2)
RESTful API Service for connectivity checks
Customizable probe configurations (connection details, target URLs, response validation, timeouts)
primary_use_case: Monitoring the availability and performance of external VPN services by acting as a Prometheus exporter.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant lighthouse keeper diligently tending to a powerful lighthouse that beams a steady, reassuring light across a stormy sea. The lighthouse itself is constructed from abstract network nodes and glowing data streams, symbolizing the VPN services. The light beam illuminates various small, distant islands, each representing a different VPN protocol (VMESS, VLESS, WireGuard, etc.), confirming their stable connection. In the foreground, a small, stylized Prometheus 'P' icon sits on a console, displaying clear, green status indicators. The overall mood is one of reliability and constant vigilance against digital storms. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a color palette emphasizing blues, greens, and the warm glow of the lighthouse.
